result_text:
I fixed the four broken default scoping conventions in `ScopingConventions.java` and added a test for them. The new `ScopingConventionsTest` passes (9 of 9). I did not run the full codeanalyzer suite.

- **`.htm` pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `(html|htm|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`, in `addGeneratedConventions`.
- **`.NET` doc XML:** the path pattern is `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path pattern is `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** the build-and-deployment pattern is `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The new test covers the positive cases (`.htm` pages, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js` with the generator comment, `build-gradle.js`), the existing matches that must still work (`.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle`), and the negative cases (hand-written `.htm`, `.html`, `.xml` and `.js` files, and `build.js`).

Changed files:
- `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`
- `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java` (new)

Nothing is committed.
